caption: The drawing shows a detailed side view of a steam locomotive on a length of railroad track. The locomotive is depicted in shades of black, brown, and gray with highlights of muted gold and green, giving it a worn metallic appearance. It features a large front cowcatcher, a smokestack, a bell, two domes on top of the boiler, and a cab with arched windows. The engine connects to a coal tender at the rear, which has decorative paneling and rides on a set of four small wheels. The locomotive itself has four large driving wheels and several smaller wheels in front. Above the locomotive and to the right, there are two small, separate illustrations: one of a horse and another of an eagle, both rendered in a similar gray-black color. The background is a plain off-white, and the composition is centered on the locomotive with the two small images positioned above and to the right.
title: Locomotive
